This '''''Harbinger'' Soldier''' served on the [[Harbinger (Hammerhead-class)|''Harbinger'']] in [[3951 BBY]]<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Sith Warship was empty, sir - we attached an umbilical and sent three teams through it, there's no sign of a crew... or its Commander|This Soldier aboard the Harbinger, clearly spooked, speaking to The [[Harbinger Captain|Captain]] about the Sith Warship|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
Serving until [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Sion|Sion]] seized command of the ship along with his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] army of [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith Assassins]]. He is seen speaking to the [[Harbinger Captain|Captain]] during one of the Captain's [[Hologram/Legends|holo]] recordings, that were discovered by [[Meetra Surik]] during her escape from Peragus.

He informs the captain that there were no signs of life aboard the Sith ship they had discovered. This soldier and his teams had been sent to investigate the vessel and, unknowingly, allowed the Sith to infiltrate the Harbinger. This led to a brief skirmish aboard the Harbinger resulting in Sion taking control of the Vessel<ref name="KOTOR2" />
